name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Adds a loading bar for slow federated starts: when a federated title is still black 1.5 seconds after play, a simple bar at the bottom shows a projected countdown, why it is taking a while, and a fun fact (admin switches for the bar, the fun-fact lookup and the fast-start analysis window; facts are fetched by the server, with a built-in fallback). Measures each friend's connection speed daily, when a server is added, and when one comes back online (Jellyfin peers and Plex), and uses it to project start times. When a title is on several friends' servers and the first choice would take over 30 seconds to start, prefers a clearly faster online source (only measured sources are ever preferred; otherwise your priority order stands). Adds timing logs for slow upstream responses and media-source resolution, and an admin diagnostic for Plex transcoding. Bounds how much of a remote file ffmpeg analyses before starting (quality is unchanged). Titles whose source reports two streams with the same index now keep their stream info instead of triggering a slow first-play probe.
